description: Returns who is authenticated: userId, email, companyId and defaultCaseFileId from GET /profile; `type`, how this MCP session authenticated (always 'UserKey', the server's only flow); and `accountLoginType`, a different fact: how the account itself signs in ('Password' or 'OpenId', from /profile, null if missing). Gives the userId that case_file_list and other user-scoped tools need; profile_get is its canonical source and returns the full profile. No parameters.
name: session_info
